verdict.rationale: Runpod documents headless, programmatic control. Its REST API v1 is explicitly for "automation systems", there is a scriptable CLI (runpodctl), and API-key authentication is supported. A runtime probe confirmed the REST API is live and key-gated as documented. GraphQL and Serverless SDKs add further non-interactive options. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive CLI auth for CI runners, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
